segments.title: Call Kass: Open Lines & Viewer Calls
segments.notes: Weekly call-in show hosted by Case Blackwell and co-host TV Cas (Cassim). Featured voicemails on horror movies, then live calls covering Token Reality's World Series tickets, Smoke Pax on Twitch regional bans and Asmongold controversy, Matt the Stat on return-to-office mandates and Asmongold's hoarder house cleanup, Snap J on concussion recovery and new puppy, Gawk Diddly on Asmongold's redemption arc, and Dylan debuting 'Movie Monday' with theatrical re-releases and DVD releases.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired its weekly Call Kass call-in program, hosted by Case Blackwell and TV Cas. The broadcast opened with horror-movie voicemails before transitioning to live callers discussing the Dodgers' World Series tickets, Twitch's Israel/Palestine signup ban, Asmongold's apology and hoarder-house cleanup, a concussion-recovering viewer's new coyote-dog puppy, and a new 'Movie Monday' segment covering theatrical re-releases and upcoming DVD drops. The show closed with subscriber shout-outs and a raid to Christian's channel.
